title: The garden behind the flats
paragraphs: A neglected patch of land behind several apartment blocks once collected litter after every storm. Residents proposed turning it into a shared garden, but some doubted that enough people would help.

The organisers began with one small bed and a weekly one-hour work session. As herbs and vegetables appeared, more neighbours joined. The garden now supplies a community kitchen and gives children a safe place to learn how food grows.
